name: ts-domain
description: Domain pack for translation surfaces, rational billiards, illumination and finite blocking: notation, a theorem sheet with real hypotheses and sources, standard examples with ids, traps, TikZ figure conventions, and verified sage-flatsurf / surface_dynamics / libgap recipes with two pure-Python scripts. One entry skill (translation-surfaces); no agents, hooks or plugin logic. Role plugins read the files by name through the academy MCP tool domain_get.
